setup.source: ARMSX2 e58489d: the BIOS folder is getExternalFilesDir(null)/bios (https://github.com/ARMSX2/ARMSX2/blob/e58489d349cdcd635fc6264546087e347c84bf8c/platforms/android/app/src/main/java/com/armsx2/runtime/MainActivityRuntime.kt#L354-L363) and, with no BIOS chosen, its top level is scanned for any valid PS2 BIOS (https://github.com/ARMSX2/ARMSX2/blob/e58489d349cdcd635fc6264546087e347c84bf8c/platforms/android/app/src/main/java/com/armsx2/runtime/MainActivityRuntime.kt#L2274-L2292).

install.source: https://github.com/ARMSX2/ARMSX2/releases; https://github.com/ARMSX2/ARMSX2/blob/master/platforms/android/app/build.gradle.kts. applicationId default com.armsx2 read from build.gradle.kts (nightly builds use a distinct id). Stable assets are ARMSX2-2.9.1-a11-armv8.2-sdk30.apk and the like, so repo only.
